findings.where: docs/41 execution erratum, Bundle/failed-attempt recovery supplement, sidecar contract, and section 6 crash tests
findings.problem: The sidecar event/state machine lacks frozen event enums, schemas, ordering, and legal transitions. Exact fsync boundaries for terminal_failed and rollback_proven are unclear, so recovery can classify the same crash differently. Torn final JSONL handling is also unspecified.
findings.required_action: Define versioned event/transition tables and durable-before-reply/retry boundaries; enumerate crash boundaries and fail closed on torn/invalid sidecar records; add table-driven restart tests.

findings.where: docs/41 sidecar recovery prose in section 3 and Bundle/failed-attempt supplement
findings.problem: The text says a restart with no receipt and lost bundle remains permanently pending_unknown, but also says terminal_failed or rollback_proven without a bundle returns not_committed. It does not clearly state whether rollback_proven is the exception or whether same-ID retry is permitted.
findings.required_action: Specify the precedence and permissible follow-up command for each durable sidecar state; receipt absence or partial attempt records must never produce not_committed.

findings.where: docs/41 fingerprint and sidecar command-HMAC contracts
findings.problem: The sidecar command HMAC inputs/version are unspecified and not explicitly compared with the canonical fingerprint/bundle digest during recovery. A same command ID with mutated semantic fields could be conflated with an existing attempt marker.
findings.required_action: Define sidecar HMAC domain/version and immutable inputs; require exact recovered fingerprint/context match and test semantic-field mutations across restart.

findings.problem: Failure handling before Registry calls is not explicitly tested despite durable attempt_started being written before Teacher.Decide and RenderLessonStartT01.
findings.required_action: Test Teacher.Decide errors, Bank/fallback validation failures, invalid output, and sidecar sync failure; assert terminal category, zero Registry/lifecycle effects, and restart behavior.

findings.where: docs/41 whole-database and mixed lifecycle verifier tests
findings.problem: The mixed A-active/B-created test and orphan receipt case do not explicitly test cross-linked audit/outbox rows or prove one lesson's facts cannot satisfy another lesson's verifier.
findings.required_action: Add cross-link corruption fixtures for audit trace and outbox decision/lesson association; assert local and global verifier outcomes.

closed_or_strengthened: sidecar intent and per-Registry-attempt sync occur outside SQLite writer lock
complete bundle digest cache and same-process rollback reuse are specified
restart with committed receipt and conservative unresolved-attempt behavior are described
Playwright uses an explicitly test-only HTML/JS harness page and preserves the case directory across supervised restart
mixed created/active lifecycle verification is separated from global database integrity checks
disposition: Do not implement until P1 findings 21-23 are resolved and test vectors are added.
